obligations.title: Local-front Fourier to Serrin
obligations.intended_claim: An actual finite physical NSE front, its strong initial L2 trace, and the full finite squared Fourier budget imply the genuine L4_t L6_x bound on the whole open front.

obligations.title: Homogeneous Fourier to Serrin
obligations.intended_claim: Jointly smooth periodic mean-zero slices and the full finite squared Fourier budget imply the genuine L4_t L6_x bound, without an assumed energy bound or global solution.

obligations.title: Physical local H1 existence
obligations.intended_claim: For nu>0 and smooth periodic solenoidal mean-zero data with H1 norm bounded by R, construct a physical smooth local solution with normalized pressure for a positive duration depending only on nu and R.

formal_obstruction.blocked_edge: cutoff-uniform physical periodic H1 local existence
formal_obstruction.cause: Galerkin lifespan may depend on N; infinite RHS loses two derivatives
formal_obstruction.required: actual norm-controlled physical local construction with pressure

obligations.title: Local strong uniqueness
obligations.intended_claim: Physical local strong solutions with the same datum agree on their common finite front; normalized pressures agree as well.

obligations.title: Maximal same-path trajectory
obligations.intended_claim: Construct the same unique maximal strong trajectory with positive extended lifetime, finite-front regularity, initial smoothness and the physical maximal-extension property.

obligations.title: Physical endpoint continuation
obligations.intended_claim: A finite integral of actual physical dissipation squared up to a finite maximal endpoint yields a bounded H1 norm and same-path physical continuation beyond that endpoint.

obligations.title: Strict cutoff overlap
obligations.intended_claim: For nonzero datum, the finite budget up to min(Tmax,Tf) implies Tf<Tmax; construct finite strict overlap times, including equality/infinite-lifetime cases.

obligations.title: Leray-Hopf identification
obligations.intended_claim: Embed the smooth physical datum into EnergySigmaZero, use Q01 actual weak existence, and identify the same weak path with the strong trajectory on every compact pre-endpoint interval.

independent_preparation.scope: input admission and Q01 existence only

obligations.title: Same-path tail and pressure gluing
obligations.intended_claim: Use Q09 on that same weak path; prove pointwise velocity and normalized-pressure agreement and glue a pair satisfying every GlobalSmoothNSE field.

obligations.title: Weak_Fourierman_B root
obligations.intended_claim: For all nu>0 and smooth periodic divergence-free mean-zero a, the full squared Fourier budget on (0,min(Tmax,Tf)), Tf=||a||_L2^4/(8*pi^2*nu^5), implies actual GlobalSmoothNSE nu a U P agreeing with the same maximal path, including zero datum and all lifetime cases.
obligations.dependency_note: Obligations01/02 are alternative analytic bridges; direct continuation uses dissipation-square integrability. Root checklist tracks all ten without implying both bridges are logically necessary.
